name: Indie Remedy (seed&stone records)
instructions: Playlist description's 'Submit' link goes to the curator's SubmitHub direct page (standard SubmitHub credits; paid option for a guaranteed listen).
notes: Description: 'indie rock, indie pop, and alt tracks with an emphasis on small growing artists'. US location from curator's own YouTube channel: 'bedroom record label and creative studio based in Asheville, NC' (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCi--SLMW_Xvf9ewQso4KPBA/about). Not Nashville as the candidate list said. That YouTube bio also lists seedandstonemusic@gmail.com but does not invite submissions by email, so emailAllowed is false.

name: Indie Rock Best of 2026 / All New Rock (The Wild Is Calling)
instructions: Playlist description: 'send us tunes (twicsubmissions@gmail.com)'. Curator's contact page also asks artists to say which playlist the track fits, and offers SubmitHub (sbmt.to/the-wild-is-calling).
notes: US location from curator's own site https://thewildiscallingus.com/about/ ('Philadelphia-based music blog covering indie rock, indie pop...'). Playlist title on Spotify now 'Indie Rock Best of 2026' (search index still shows 'All New Rock 2026').

name: EAR SALT (Elton Audio Records)
instructions: Pick the playlist on eltonaudio.com/playlist-submissions, follow it on Spotify (ToneDen follow-gate), then paste your Spotify track link. Free. The playlist description says 'For placements, email submissions@eltonaudio.com'.
notes: Same US label as EAR INDIE. Modern alt rock ('punchy guitars, driving drums'). The email is in the Spotify description, not on the website. Separate paid EAR Pitch service exists; playlist submission is free. Small playlist. The Spotify playlist description also gives submissions@eltonaudio.com, but the website shows only the form, so email is left null here.

name: Fresh Finds From East of 8th (East of 8th Music Blog)
instructions: Email working links to George Maifair at eof8th@gmail.com; prefers unreleased/upcoming LPs/EPs; no longer uses SubmitHub; they can't reply to everything.
notes: Site tagline: indie rock, alternative and indie pop. Homepage says 'Based out of Nashville, Tennessee'. The playlist is embedded on the site as 'Indie rock, alternative, and indie pop tracks selected by the editors'. Sister site Mother Church Pew sends its indie/alt submissions here.

name: EAR INDIE (Elton Audio Records)
instructions: Pick the playlist on eltonaudio.com/playlist-submissions, follow it on Spotify (ToneDen follow-gate), then paste your Spotify track link; they email you if added. Free. The playlist description also says to email submissions@eltonaudio.com.
notes: Elton Audio Records: hybrid label/management company; its About page says it is 'based in the United States' (team in PT/MT/CT/ET). Laid-back indie rock/dream pop. The email is in the Spotify playlist description, not on the website. The label also sells a separate paid 'EAR Pitch' service; playlist submission itself is free. Playlist URL taken from the label's Spotify profile, which the site links to. Small playlist. The Spotify playlist description also gives submissions@eltonaudio.com, but the website shows only the form, so email is left null here.

name: New Rock Drive: Indie & Alt Rock 2026 (Unique Playlists)
instructions: Use the 'Submit your song' direct link on uniqueplaylists.com (a paid premium listen via SubmitHub, 5 credits); also on SubmitLink, Groover, Playlist Push. One submission covers all their playlists.
notes: Site calls this playlist ROCK NEWS; Spotify title now 'New Rock Drive'. Last add 16 Oct 2026 per site. Says placement is not for sale. Large curator (claims 500k followers across platforms).

name: Alternative Weekly 2026 / Best New Indie Music 2026 (Indiemono)
instructions: Paste a released, public Spotify track link into the form, add 1-3 tags and a main vibe, submit. One submission reaches all Indiemono playlists. Free. No reply unless added. One submission per track. No covers or AI music. Unreleased songs go via their demos page.
notes: Madrid-based network of 150+ playlists (About page: '2015 · Madrid'). Updated every New Music Friday. One form submission reaches all Indiemono playlists, including Alt Rock 2026 below; submit once.

name: Cool stuff - Indie & Alternative Pop and Rock Discoveries (H-Music)
instructions: Pick a platform on the H-Music submit page: Groover, SubmitHub, Ko-fi or Magic Nothing.
notes: Indie pop/rock, post-punk and alt playlist for emerging artists, open to international acts. Groover is paid; SubmitHub can be free or premium. The page lists h-music@orange.fr only as a general contact, not for submissions. I couldn't see a recent activity date.

name: Indie Rock Peanut Butter Shake (Indieshake)
instructions: Playlist submissions go through their SubmitHub link ('Click here to submit to our playlists'). The site also has a short form asking for name, email, track/artist and Spotify URL. The label says new talent can email indieshakerecords@gmail.com.
notes: Swedish indie label and tastemaker. Its roster includes UK act Fran Lusty, so it takes international artists. SubmitHub has free standard credits, and premium credits are paid. The email is aimed at label A&R ('new talent'), not at playlists by name. Recent activity is unclear: the site shows no dates. Sister playlist Indie Chocolate Shake has 10,830 saves. Site returns a bot-block (410) to scripts; opens normally in a browser.

name: ROCK YOUR GUT | All Rage Into One List (iMusician)
instructions: Click 'Submit your track' on the iMusician Rock Your Gut page (ToneDen submission page). For independent rock artists: indie rock, hard rock, psych rock.
notes: Run by distributor iMusician (Zurich). Page invites independent rock musicians generally; doesn't say non-iMusician artists are excluded. ToneDen pages may be follow-gated.

name: Must Listen: International Rock, Pop, Electro & Folk (IndieTapes)
instructions: Submit via Musosoup or SubmitHub (no email route). Blog reviews and adds to the biweekly-rotated playlist.
notes: Germany-based blog, posting daily (Nov 2026), lots of indie rock reviews, international artists. Musosoup is paid; SubmitHub has free/premium. Site sits behind a JS browser check (open in a real browser). Same editor (Adrian) as BerlinOnAir and NewIndieRadar; pitch only one of the three.

name: Alt Rock 2026 / Today's Alternative Rock & Indie Rock (Indiemono)
instructions: Paste a released, public Spotify track link into the form, add 1-3 tags and a main vibe, submit. One submission reaches all Indiemono playlists. Free. No reply unless added. One submission per track. No covers or AI music. Unreleased songs go via their demos page.
notes: Same Indiemono form as Alternative Weekly; one submission covers both, so don't double-submit.

name: Indie Aisle (EARMILK)
instructions: EARMILK accepts submissions only through SubmitHub or Pillargram (per earmilk.com/submit). Pitch the indie rock track via SubmitHub.
notes: EARMILK says it is based in the US and Canada. The page doesn't say SubmitHub pitches feed this playlist; that's inferred.

name: these songs live in my head (Ryan Cassata / Rock The Pigeon)
instructions: Single reviews and playlist placements only via SubmitHub; the site says it only accepts premium (paid) single submissions. Do not email staff.
notes: Blog 'based in California's Bay Area' (rockthepigeon.com/about/). Playlist genres per description: Indie Pop, Rock, Alt, Folk Punk, Hip Hop, Punk. Broad mix, so fit is medium. Playlist URL was embedded on rockthepigeon.com. Its other embedded playlist (QUEERS TO THE FRONT) is themed, so I left it out.

name: Mad Indie Media Monthly Playlist (Mad Indie Media)
instructions: Fill out the playlist submission form on madindiemedia.com; all submissions welcome; they ask you to follow and stream their playlists. Playlist updated on the 1st of each month.
notes: Blog and collective founded in New Jersey in 2020 (homepage). Monthly all-genre mix, heavy on punk/indie/math rock. Small playlist (72 saves). Playlist embedded on madindiemedia.com/playlists/.

name: Swim Into The Sound 2026 (Swim Into The Sound / georgetaylorg)
instructions: Email streams, downloads, links or videos to swimintothesound@gmail.com; downloads preferred.
notes: US team per /swim-team: founder Taylor Grimes was born in Portland, Oregon, and writers are based in Brooklyn, Chicago, DC and northern California. Leans emo/post-hardcore/indie rock. The playlists are yearly logs of the site's coverage with few saves; Emo Census 2023 (open.spotify.com/playlist/4c9E8erq8gDy7hWnVGmO6O) has 429. A submission is pitched to the blog, and a playlist add follows coverage.

name: Best New Indie & Alternative Songs of the Month (Grimy Goods)
instructions: First add your song to Grimy Goods' open Spotify submission playlist (https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7kn4J6vwFoPuClCDQEvYdx). Release date must fall in the current month. Then email your pitch and PR kit to hello@grimygoods.com. Picks move to the Best Songs of the Month playlist, and about 75% of editorials come from it.
notes: Independent LA music media outlet, est. 2008 (about page: 'a Los Angeles-based independent music media network'). Submission playlist says 'we lean indie and alt across all genres'. Email is written as hello(at)grimygoods(dot)com on the page. Playlist URL comes from the page's bit.ly/BestNewSongs link, and Spotify og:url confirms it. Follower count isn't readable.

name: The Current Indie & New Unknown Artists (J.Scalco)
instructions: Follow the playlist and follow J.Scalco on Spotify (steps 1 and 2), then submit name + Spotify link via the form on the page. Indie, alternative or pop.
notes: Solo artist/blogger's own playlist. Follow-gated submissions. US location from his about page (from New Orleans, moved to California); current city not stated. Spotify follower count not readable. Page blocks curl; read via WebFetch.

name: Alt - alt-pop, alt-rock, alt-electronic, alt-jazz (H-Music)
instructions: Pick a platform on the H-Music submit page: Groover, SubmitHub, Ko-fi or Magic Nothing.
notes: Same curator as Cool stuff. Broader mix of alternative genres (electronic and jazz as well as rock), so a weaker fit for straight indie rock.

name: EVERYTHING INDIE | Alternative gems from across the world (iMusician)
instructions: Click 'Submit your track' on the iMusician playlist page, which opens a Hypeddit submission page. Updated about monthly.
notes: Run by distributor iMusician (Zurich HQ). The page doesn't say whether non-iMusician artists are eligible; it just invites indie artists. Hypeddit pages are often follow-gated.

name: Nialler9 Weekly (Nialler9 / Niall Byrne)
instructions: Email promos, track streams, premiere offers, album links and releases to newmusic@nialler9.com. Give as much notice before release as you can, and don't chase. (irish@nialler9.com is for Irish artists only.)
notes: Weekly new-music playlist mixing Irish and international acts, broad indie/alt plus electronic. The site says the general inbox gets about 250 emails a day, so a listen isn't guaranteed. Active: weekly playlist posts in 2025. Address is Cloudflare-obfuscated in the page source; visible in a normal browser.

name: NEW PUNK | Curated by Talkin' Chaos (iMusician)
instructions: Click 'Submit your track' on the iMusician New Punk page (ToneDen submission page).
notes: Punk / pop-punk / skate punk; only fits FloodLines' punkier tracks. Eligibility for non-iMusician artists not stated.

name: NewIndieRadar - #NowPlaying (NewIndieRadar)
instructions: Submit via TrackReviewr only (free, no login); email submissions not considered.
notes: Independent German blog covering folk, pop, rock and classical. Site behind a JS browser check. Same team as IndieTapes/BerlinOnAir. Site blocks scripted access; open in a real browser.

name: IndieForBunnies Brand New (IndieForBunnies)
instructions: Email the music to indieforbunnies@gmail.com for review or the 'Brand New' column. They only reply if they cover it. The playlist collects tracks from the Brand New column.
notes: Italian webzine covering international indie-rock, folk, shoegaze and dreampop. The email is invited for reviews and features, not for the playlist by name. The playlist is fed from the Brand New column. Active: reviews dated Nov 2026.

name: Weekly Fresh by NINE:32
instructions: Email press mails, review submissions or premiere offers to info@nine32.nl.
notes: Dutch alternative music webzine. The playlist adds new alternative tracks every Saturday. The email invites review and press submissions; the contact page doesn't name the playlist itself. Small playlist (183 saves). Site footer says 2026.

name: Emergentes MZK (Muzikalia)
instructions: Bands and new projects take part in #EmergentesMZK by emailing 7minutos@muzikalia.com. Each Wednesday a post picks 7 songs, which go into the 50-song Emergentes MZK playlist. The playlist rotates every week.
notes: Spanish-language webzine, but the picks include non-Spanish acts (e.g. Miss Kill from Bristol). Active: weekly post dated 4 Nov 2026. Email is in the site-wide footer contact block (the old /contacto/ page now 404s).

name: Jungle Indie Rock - 2026, Vol. 1 (Raw Critters, formerly Jungle Indie Rock)
instructions: Use the 'Fill the form' Tumblr submission link: 1 track or 1 video only, released within the last 3 months; embed a Soundcloud/Bandcamp track (or YouTube/Vimeo link) with caption 'Band Name – Track Name' plus links. Selected tracks get posted and may go into their playlists.
notes: Spain-based indie blog founded 2010 (About page: 'group of journalists and music lovers based in Spain'). Playlist is international (17 countries) but tiny (10 saves); value is the blog feature. Submissions posts dated Dec 2025.

name: Discovery: The Best New Music (The AU Review)
instructions: Email the editorial team with the music pitch. A premiere (7+ days notice) guarantees a spot in the Discovery playlist. The site says it is not pay-for-play, and its volunteer team may not reply.
notes: The playlist covers new music from Australia and around the world. The email on the contact page is Cloudflare-obfuscated but shows in a browser.

name: The AAA Backstage Weekly Catch - Freshest Tunes
instructions: Pitch through the direct Gumroad submission ($10, no guaranteed placement, feedback within 72h). Musosoup or Groover also work. Picks feature in The Weekly Slap and the Weekly Catch playlist.
notes: The submission page says 'we have a soft spot for indie rock, indie dance, post punk and alt-pop'. Musosoup: https://app.musosoup.com/submit/aaabackstage

name: MixTape (Acid Stag Radio)
instructions: Submit via Gumroad (about A$15 to cover listening time, placement not guaranteed, feedback if unsuccessful). A SoundCloud link is required. The release must be no more than 2 weeks old.
notes: The playlist description reads 'all submissions: https://acidstag.gumroad.com'. Eclectic, not rock-only. The Australian base is from search snippets only.

name: Northern Transmissions Top Indie Songs of 2025
instructions: Email the music pitch to the address on the About page.
notes: Small year-end list. There's also a monthly playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/27BhmLAKzrqXfaLGRYB9CR

name: Indie Twang & Beyond (Happy Medium Co.)
instructions: Current playlist description ends 'Updated Weekly. hmcosubmissions@gmail.com'; earlier indexed version read 'Email submissions to hmcosubmissions@gmail.com'.
notes: Small (54 saves); twangy indie/folk-rock lean. US location rests on the curator's Spotify profile name 'Happy Medium, TN' (open.spotify.com/user/31hkanxypjecfv5tzf5lbeg4e7p4) and Instagram @happymediumtn bio 'Nashville, TN' (seen in search snippet only; IG not readable by curl). Weaker location proof than TWIC.

name: Cozy Indie & Folk 2026 (Unique Playlists)
instructions: Same single Unique Playlists submission (SubmitHub direct link); curator routes to whichever playlist fits.
notes: Leans cozy/acoustic indie folk; only fits softer FloodLines tracks. Same submission as the rock row, don't double-pitch.

name: BerlinOnAir: Indie Folk & Rock Radio (Berlin On Air)
instructions: Submit via TrackReviewr (free, no login); also on Musosoup and SubmitHub. No email submissions.
notes: Says it likes indie folk, singer-songwriter, soul, piano and jazz, so a weak fit for indie rock. Email explicitly not for music. Same team as IndieTapes/NewIndieRadar. Site blocks scripted access; open in a real browser.

name: New Indie Music: Happy's Mixtape (Happy Mag)
instructions: Share a recently released track via the Happy Mag submit form ('We listen to everything').
notes: The playlist features new Australian indie, rock and alt. The form is for editorial coverage and doesn't mention the playlist.

name: Spotlight (soundsol)
instructions: Email submissions to the address in the playlist description.
notes: All-genre playlist. The Canadian location comes only from a Groover blog mention, so it's unverified.

name: Spincoaster: Best New Music
instructions: Email the press address listed on the Spincoaster About page.
notes: Tokyo-based music media. Picks come from its Monday Spin column. The genre mix is broad.

name: Indie Australian Rock (Sad Alpaca Music)
instructions: Playlist description: 'Send your music: sadalpaca@hotmail.com'.
notes: Tiny playlist. The curator's country is unknown and the focus is Australian rock.
